instruction: Remove the orange traffic cone logo that VLC displays when no media is loaded.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated VLC > Tools > Preferences > Interface, checked 'Start in minimal view mode', saved preferences, and restarted VLC to verify persistence.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can launch VLC, navigate to Tools > Preferences, find and toggle checkbox settings in Interface tab, save preferences
metadata.task_rationale: Same interaction pattern (toggle VLC preference setting) but different target: disable the background cone logo instead of enabling minimal view. Both are checkboxes in the same Interface preferences panel.
metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the VLC background cone (orange traffic cone logo shown when no media is loaded). Evaluator reads vlcrc config file and checks that qt-bgcone=0. Default is 1 (enabled), so agent must uncheck the option in Preferences > Interface.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter (vlc_config) correctly reads the vlcrc config file from the VM, which is the right source for VLC preference settings.
Metric (check_qt_bgcone) correctly parses the vlcrc file for the 'qt-bgcone' key and compares against expected value 0 (disabled).
Expected value handling is correct: get_rule returns {"expected_qt_bgcone": 0}, and the metric accesses rule['expected_qt_bgcone'] directly — proper parameter handling for type='rule'.
Postconfig correctly kills VLC (forcing config write to disk) then relaunches it, ensuring vlcrc reflects the saved preferences.
The qt-bgcone setting is the correct VLC config key controlling the orange traffic cone background logo. Value 0 means disabled, matching the instruction to remove it.
Complete coverage: single-requirement instruction (remove cone logo) is fully verified by checking qt-bgcone=0.
